levels.surface: بعجة بن، عبد الله بن بدر

notes: «كلاهما عن أبي حازم» is the convergence of the two co-transmitters of قتيبة, so it is one level of co-transmitters (rule 2)
«- يعني ابن عبد الرحمن القاري -» is an editor's gloss, left out (rule 1)
«وقال عن بعجة بن، عبد الله بن بدر» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route; only its name is written, the rest of its route is not in the text
«مثله» and «خلاف رواية يحيى» are wording remarks, left out
